newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines passenger aircraft lands at Madras military base by mistake.
- Saudi, Ukrainian officials hammer out draft trade agreement.
- Saudi Arabia's Jeraisy Computer and Communication Services awards 47 million riyal contract to run and maintain the information centre of Meteorology and Environmental Protection Agency.
- Mecca governor to lay foundation stone for 500 million riyal tourism projects on Tuesday.
- Saudi Methanol Company signs contract to build a fourth 850,000 metric tonnes a year methanol plant.
- King Fahd urges world to save Middle East peace process.
- Saudi Arabia plans to launch water projects worth 53 million riyals in its eastern province.
